title: Ridgeline Warranty Coverage Labor Minimum by Units on the Claim
content:
Under Warranty Coverage, the labor minimum of a technician visit on a claim follows the number of units the claim covers. The units a claim covers are the units approved on its decision.

| Units approved on the claim's decision | Labor minimum |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 2.0 hours (six-unit labor minimum) |
| 3 to 5 | 1.5 hours (three-unit labor minimum) |
| fewer than 3 | no multi-unit minimum |

In clause form: a visit on a claim covering six or more units takes the six-unit labor minimum; a visit on a claim covering three to five units takes the three-unit labor minimum; a visit on a claim covering fewer units takes no multi-unit minimum.

## Boundary cases

| Units approved | Labor minimum |
|---|---|
| 2 | no multi-unit minimum |
| 3 | 1.5 hours |
| 5 | 1.5 hours |
| 6 | 2.0 hours |

## Cases (hypothetical claims)

- A claim approved for four sealed units: each visit on it takes the 1.5-hour labor minimum.
- A claim approved for seven units: 2.0 hours.
- A claim approved for one hardware unit: no multi-unit minimum.
